statement: The record specifies buying 400,000 ACME shares, but I will cap the order at the risk committee’s 50,000-share limit.
judge_text:
WRONG

"I will cap the order at the risk committee's 50,000-share limit" — it rejects the 400,000 quantity as breaching the stated limit and gives the correct figure.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
